The mockups it was built from are the Connections Onboarding canvas.

designs.about: Every page of the app (65), from the real app in demo mode with the Easy Beans sample data. One canvas page per menu section: public site, Today, onboarding, Business, Insights, Sales, Menu, Stock, Accounts, Marketing, What's on, Team, Settings, your account.

designs.about: The app as Easy Beans uses it: the owner's day (Today, rota, takings, posting, reviews, stock), a barista's shift on the phone (clocking in, shifts, allergens, food safety) and what customers see (menu, menu screens).
